item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President states an Administration policy directing agencies toward flexible use of regulatory tools; it guides future discretionary implementation without itself changing legal rights or requiring a specified legal outcome.","evidence":"It is the policy of my Administration to use available tools to confront the urgent challenges facing the Nation"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately revokes prior executive orders governing internal regulatory administration, a form of executive-branch reorganization expressly treated as internal management under the codebook.","evidence":"are hereby revoked"},{"segment_id":"3","code":2,"rationale":"The OMB Director and agency heads are mandatorily directed to pursue later rescission of implementing rules and policies; the legally consequential rescissions occur through subsequent agency action under applicable law.","evidence":"shall promptly take steps to rescind any orders, rules, regulations, guidelines, or policies"},{"segment_id":"4","code":4,"rationale":"The segment inseparably combines a mandate for officials to provide later exemptions, which is a dictated legal outcome, with the immediate abolition of internal executive positions and entities, which is administrative housekeeping, plus savings provisions.","evidence":"shall promptly take steps to provide all available exemptions"}]}
